Description: XIAO ESP32-S3 module (plain; not Sense)
Notes: Buy from Seeed or a distributor. U.FL antenna only (the antenna ships in the box). BAT+/BAT- pads are on the underside: see docs/PCB-Notes.md for soldering them through the plated slots

Description: 16-bit I2C I/O expander with 100k internal pull-ups
Notes: Same pinout and registers as TCA9555, which has no SOIC package. Address 0x20 (A0-A2 to GND). Alt: TCA9555PWR (TSSOP-24 0.65 mm, LCSC C465732)

Description: 3.0 V low-noise LDO with enable (stick supply)
Notes: Needs 1 uF in and out. Drop-in alt: TPS7A2030PDBVR (LCSC C963429)

Description: Load switch 5.5 V 2 A, active-high ON (cuts LED power in sleep)
Notes: 10 nA off, 0.5 uA on, ~90 mOhm. ON = STICK_EN. CT and QOD left open. Not the TPS22917L, which has an active-low ON

Description: FPC connector, 5-pos 0.5 mm, bottom contact (Joy-Con stick flex)
Notes: Finest pitch on the board: fine tip, plenty of flux, check for bridges. Bottom-contact only, so a flipped flex just doesn't connect. Don't substitute a dual-contact connector such as the Hirose FH34SRJ: see docs/PCB-Notes.md

Description: JST PH 2-pin SMT vertical (top entry), battery
Notes: Battery polarity isn't standardized between vendors; check before plugging in

Description: Carbon contact pads on the main board (D-pad, face, Select, Start, Home): PCB copper, no part
Notes: Order the board with ENIG finish. D-pad/face: 5.5 mm round for 4.5 mm pills; Select/Start: 2 x 3 mm pills; Home: 3 x 3 mm pills (4.5 mm pitch)

Description: PS3 DualShock 3 replacement conductive rubber pads
Notes: Pills: D-pad/face 4.5 mm; Start/Select 2 x 3 mm and Home 3 x 3 mm on a 4.5 mm pitch

Description: Tactile switch, top-actuated, on the shoulder daughterboards (L1/R1 upper, L2/R2 lower)
Notes: Footprint SamacSys:PTS526SM15SMTR2LFS. Pads 1+2 = COM

Designator: J4 J5 + shoulder board J1 (x2 boards)
Description: JST PH 3-pin SMT side-entry, shoulder cable (main board J4/J5, one per shoulder board)
Notes: Same part on both ends. Pin 1 upper (L1/R1), 2 lower (L2/R2), 3 GND

Description: JST PH 3-pin cable, socket both ends, pin 1 to pin 1
Notes: Or pre-crimped PH leads. Length set by the enclosure. A reversed cable loses L2/R2

Description: Addressable RGB LED (WL-ICLED), WS2812 protocol, top-emitting
Notes: VDD 3.5-5.5 V: power from LED_VDD (+BATT through U4). VIH 0.7*VDD (2.94 V at 4.2 V), so 3.3 V data has ~0.36 V margin at full charge. Pinout differs from WS2812B (1 VSS, 2 DIN, 3 VDD, 4 DOUT): use the SamacSys:1315050930002 symbol and footprint. ~1 mA standby each, so U4 cuts their power in sleep. Iron-solderable pads
